name: GeoAssets Tri-Planar Multi-Agent Planning & Architecture Verification DAG
description: Declarative read-only Outer-Loop planning blueprint for Google Antigravity coordinating Claude Code (Architecture/Domain Reasoning) and GitHub Copilot (Type Signatures/xUnit QA Matrix) with a Deterministic Plan Oracle and zero source-code mutations.

metadata.targetStack: .NET 10 (C# 14, Blazor WASM, MAUI, ASP.NET Core, EF Core/PostGIS, NetTopologySuite)
metadata.architectureModel: Tri-Planar Dual-Loop Read-Only Planning with Deterministic Plan Oracle

orchestrator.role: Planning DAG Orchestrator, Codebase Grounder, Deterministic Plan Oracle Gatekeeper, and Artifact Synthesizer

reasoningSpecialist.role: Domain Architecture, Onion Layer Boundaries, Spatial/Topology/Workflow Strategy, Risk Assessment, and Sequenced Task Decomposition

mechanicalWorker.role: Concrete C# 14 Type/Interface Contract Drafting, Disjoint File Touch Manifest, DomainTestDataBuilders Blueprint, and 100%-Branch xUnit Test Matrix

taskId.description: Jira ticket key or task slug (e.g., 'XD01-195-spatial-buffer-cache')

outputPath.description: Optional file path (--out) if the user explicitly requests exporting the Markdown plan beyond the Antigravity conversation artifact.

phases.name: Phase 1: Read-Only Baseline Snapshot & Scope Grounding

steps.description: Record baseline working-tree status to enforce the zero-code-change invariant across all phases. Do not create worktrees, branches, or commits.

Resolve Jira ticket/prose requirements (checking both formal 'Blocks' links and prose 'Depends on' references), locate existing target projects/interfaces in GeoAssets.sln, and partition planning inputs into (A) architectureBrief for Claude Code and (B) testAndScaffoldingBrief for GitHub Copilot.

phases.name: Phase 2: Parallel Read-Only Specialist Dispatch (Claude Code + GitHub Copilot)

instructions: Operate strictly in READ-ONLY mode: do not create, edit, or delete any files.
Design the domain model, Onion Architecture boundaries (zero EF Core/Npgsql/PostGIS dependencies in core/), RFC 7946 coordinate-array source-of-truth rules, and observability/UI impacts.
Specify System.TimeProvider and CancellationToken propagation across all proposed async workflows.
Produce a sequenced implementation task breakdown, risk/trade-off matrix, and the exact coreLogicSpec file list for Branch 2A of /code-gen-dag.
Operate strictly in READ-ONLY mode: do not create, edit, or delete any files.
Draft concrete C# 14 / .NET 10 type and interface contracts (readonly record struct, sealed record, JsonSerializerContext, ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull) as plan snippets.
Build the file-by-file touch manifest ([NEW]/[MODIFY]) enforcing .razor + .razor.cs code-behind separation and test project conventions.

Design an exhaustive xUnit [Fact]/[Theory] test matrix (happy paths, guard clauses, boundary conditions, FakeTimeProvider, cancellation) plus DomainTestDataBuilders and NSubstitute mocks targeting 100% branch coverage.
Produce the exact testAndBoilerplateSpec file list for Branch 2B of /code-gen-dag.

checks: Stage 1 (Code 10): Every [MODIFY] file and referenced project exists on disk; Razor components include .razor + .razor.cs pairs; coreLogicSpecPlan and testAndBoilerplateSpecPlan file sets have zero intersection (100% disjoint).

Stage 2 (Code 20): Proposed C# signatures/snippets contain zero BannedSymbols.txt APIs (DateTime.Now/UtcNow, DateTimeOffset.Now/UtcNow, .Result, .Wait, Thread.Sleep) and zero #pragma warning disable or <NoWarn>.

Stage 3 (Code 30): Zero core/ -> Infrastructure/EF Core/Npgsql/PostGIS dependency violations; RFC 7946 [lon, lat] & SRID 4326 respected; every planned public method/branch has matching xUnit test cases.

phases.name: Phase 4: Plan Self-Healing Feedback Loop (Bounded Retry)

onMaxIterationsExceeded.message: Plan Oracle still flagged unresolved architectural or contract issues after {{parameters.maxSelfHealRetries}} iterations. Presenting draft with explicit open decisions for human review.

routingRules.instructions: Correct non-existent [MODIFY] file paths against the real workspace tree, enforce .razor + .razor.cs pairing, and eliminate any overlapping file ownership between Branch 2A and Branch 2B.
Refactor proposed C# contracts to inject System.TimeProvider, propagate CancellationToken asynchronously, and remove any banned APIs or analyzer suppressions; sync updated signatures with Branch 2B.
Eliminate core/ coupling to infrastructure/PostGIS via domain ports in core/ and adapters in providers/workflow/, and instruct GitHub Copilot to add missing xUnit branch/guard test cases.

sections: 4. Disjoint File-Ownership Manifest (Branch 2A Claude Code vs. Branch 2B GitHub Copilot)

steps.description: If --out <path> was explicitly supplied, export a copy there; otherwise confirm 'git status --porcelain' remains identical to Phase 1 baseline (zero repository changes).
